relation: Image of a supplied finite set: for f : T -> U between finite types and e : {set T}, the set of f x for x in e, MathComp's f @: e (imset, the HB-locked imset.body). The corpus bounded-existential body [set y | [exists x, (x \in e) && (y == f x)]] equals it by a proved set equality (GTBase.set_images.imset_existsE), not by conversion. X117/X119 are its ordinal-codomain instances. No injectivity, nonempty set or carrier, positive host order or no-isolated guard; the copy predicates keep their own injection guard, and the cardinality equality needs injectivity. Packing XE1 xe1_image_edges (a whole host edge family) and the necklace image_set are separate representations; copy/forcing/Ramsey ownership is not migrated here.
summary: D3 turns X108, X117 and X119 image_edge into aliases of MathComp f @: e (imset); the corpus bounded-existential body is proved equal (GTBase.set_images.imset_existsE), the lock forbidding conversion. No injection, nonempty or no-isolated guard; the copy predicates keep their injection.

Frozen at the D2 pin: 3 sources, 8 chains (copies with the same colour/injective map, two-colour and q-colour forcing, both Ramsey-number predicates with forcing and minimality) and 3 complete current rows. Two complete A10+D1+D3 Originals (X108, X119) are bound at the complete-history source 9e03072 and reuse D1 raw uniformity and A10 d-degeneracy: 5 whole-statement iff.
The four certified A10/D1 support objects are listed in the historical role; four older partial snapshots stay byte-exact (known_stale_snapshots). X117 has no earlier snapshot.
X119 keeps its no-isolated guard and the ceiling square root with its opaque x119_sqrt_ex witness; statuses, legs and docs are unchanged. Public client: base/theories/examples/set_images.v.
